description: An open yellow tabletop holds a white wireless earbud case and two white earbuds, with a red cloth backdrop behind. The left hand steadies and flips open the case, while the right hand picks up an earbud from the table and lowers it into a slot in the case; the right hand then places the second earbud inside, and both hands bring the lid down to close the case, making the case a two-hand object while it’s being shut.
